reading: Alison Hammond feared she was having a heart attack on live TV.
She went to the hospital for a heart check-up.
But it was a panic attack, not a heart attack.
She said, "I couldn't catch my breath and I genuinely thought I was having a heart attack."
Panic attacks can happen to anyone.
A panic attack can feel like a heart attack because symptoms are similar.
You can try to calm yourself by breathing slowly.

vocabulary.definition: worried or believed something bad would happen.
a serious medical problem when blood flow to the heart stops.
television broadcast happening at the same time it is filmed.
a medical examination to see if you are healthy.
a sudden feeling of strong fear, stress, or anxiety.
to breathe normally again after effort or stress.
to make yourself feel quiet and relaxed.
